title: Varmora Granito IPO Details
intro:
Varmora Granito IPO is a book build issue of ₹1,096.04 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 2.16 crore shares aggregating to ₹320.00 crores and offer for sale of 5.24 crore shares aggregating to ₹776.04 crores.

Varmora Granito IPO opens for subscription on Sep 22, 2026 and closes on Sep 24, 2026. The allotment for the Varmora Granito IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 25, 2026. Varmora Granito IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 29, 2026.

Varmora Granito IPO is set issue price band at ₹140 to ₹148 per share. The lot size for an application is 101 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,948 (101 shares) (based on upper price).

JM Financial Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Varmora Granito IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

faqs.question: How to apply in Varmora Granito IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Varmora Granito IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Varmora Granito IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Varmora Granito IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Varmora Granito IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Varmora Granito IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Varmora Granito IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Varmora Granito IPO will be done on Friday, September 25, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Sep 28, 2026 . Check the Varmora Granito IPO allotment status .

faqs.answer: The Varmora Granito IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Tue, Sep 29, 2026 .
